integrity: The source files are complete and the numerical checker is included; arithmetic simulations are diagnostics, not proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact elementary cumulative distribution is proved only for m=2. The fixed-dimensional endpoint asymptotics and separate growing-dimensional weak limit are not jointly uniform. Equal-radius disks must share an axis and span orthogonal planes. Some Dirichlet-order-statistic identities may have unindexed earlier formulations. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
title: Common-axis disk hulls: exact three-dimensional widths and sharp high-dimensional laws
